fields.label: PayEngine Status
fields.name: payengine_status
fields.instructions: Only switch to Live once the keys below are real live-mode keys from your PayEngine dashboard, not the pk_test_/sk_test_ ones.

fields.label: PayEngine Public Key
fields.name: payengine_public_key
fields.instructions: From PayEngine dashboard → API Keys. Starts with pk_test_ (sandbox) or pk_live_ (real charges). Safe to expose publicly — this loads in the customer's browser.

fields.label: PayEngine API Host
fields.name: payengine_host
fields.instructions: The PayEngine API host used by the customer's browser to tokenize card/ACH details. Leave as-is unless PayEngine support tells you live mode uses a different URL.

fields.label: PayEngine Server API URL
fields.name: payengine_api_url
fields.instructions: From PayEngine dashboard. The server-to-server endpoint NDS's site calls to actually run the charge after the customer submits payment. Different from the host above.

fields.label: PayEngine Merchant ID
fields.name: payengine_merchant_id
fields.instructions: From PayEngine dashboard — identifies your merchant account on each charge.
